item.description:
Benefits of Sensodyne Complete Protection Original Toothpaste:

• One complete sensitivity toothpaste, specially designed with seven benefits*

• Helps to relieve sensitive teeth issues, strengthen enamel, leaves your breath feeling fresh, helps to maintain healthy gums, helps restore natural whiteness of teeth, and helps control dental plaque

• Contains fluoride that strengthens teeth and fights tooth decay

• Contains Stannous Fluoride which is an anti-gingivitis agent

• Clinically proven relief and daily protection for sensitive teeth

*With twice daily brushing



Kebaikan ubat gigi Sensodyne Complete Protection Original:

• Ubat gigi sensitiviti lengkap yang dirumus khas dengan tujuh faedah*

• Membantu melegakan masalah gigi sensitif, menguatkan enamel, membantu nafas terasa segar, membantu memelihara gusi yang sihat, membantu memulihkan keputihan semula jadi gigi, dan membantu mengawal plak gigi

• Mengandungi fluorida yang menguatkan gigi dan melawan pereputan gigi

• Mengandungi Stannous Fluoride yang merupakan agen anti-gingivitis

• Kelegaan dan perlindungan harian untuk gigi sensitif yang terbukti secara klinikal

*Dengan memberus gigi dua kali sehari
